programs.description: List of mtail program definitions (regex patterns + metric rules + code).

match.description: Glob or regex pattern for matching log lines.

labels.description: Static labels to apply to metrics from this program.

metrics.description: List of metric definitions (counters, gauges, histograms).

type.description: Metric type: counter, gauge, or histogram.

buckets.description: Bucket boundaries for histogram (only for histogram type).

program.description: mtail program code (Go-like syntax with regex capture groups and metric operations).

log_patterns.description: List of glob patterns for log files to tail.

output_path.description: HTTP path where metrics are exposed (e.g., /metrics).

server_port.description: HTTP server port for serving metrics.

log_level.description: Verbosity of mtail's own logs. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error.
